He was the 2010 [[Big West Conference]] [[Big West Conference Men's Basketball Player of the Year|player of the year]] and an [[2010 NCAA Men's Basketball All-Americans|All-American]]. ==College career== Johnson, a 6'5" [[Guard (basketball)|guard]] from [[Palma High School]] in [[Salinas, California]], first played collegiately at [[Loyola Marymount Lions men's basketball|Loyola Marymount]]. As a freshman in the [[2007–08 NCAA Division I men's basketball season|2007–08 season]], Johnson averaged 12.4 [[Points per game|points]] and 4.9 [[rebounds per game]], leading the Lions in both categories. Following a coaching change at LMU, Johnson transferred to UCSB.{{cite web| title = UCSB Lands Loyola Marymount Transfer Orlando Johnson| publisher = UCSB Athletics| year = 2008 | url =http://ucsbgauchos.com/sports/m-baskbl/spec-rel/060608aaa.html| accessdate = December 30, 2011}} After sitting out the [[2008–09 NCAA Division I men's basketball season|2008–09 season]] per [[National Collegiate Athletic Association|NCAA]] transfer rules, Johnson made an instant impact in the Big West Conference for the Gauchos, averaging 18 points and 5.9 rebounds per game. Johnson also led the Gauchos to the [[2010 Big West Conference Men's Basketball Tournament]] title and an NCAA appearance. Following the season, he was named the Big West conference player of the year and an honorable mention All-American by the [[Associated Press]].{{cite web| title = Johnson, Williams Earn Top Big West Honors| publisher = UCSB Athletics| year = 2010 | url =http://www.ucsbgauchos.com/sports/m-baskbl/spec-rel/030810aaa.html| accessdate = December 30, 2011}} As a junior in [[2010–11 NCAA Division I men's basketball season|2010–11]], Johnson averaged 21.1 points and 6.2 rebounds per game and was again named first team All-Big West. He also led the Gauchos to another conference tournament title and NCAA tournament appearance, again earning [[2011 Big West Conference Men's Basketball Tournament|Big West tournament]] MVP honors. Following his junior season, Johnson declared himself eligible for the [[2011 NBA Draft]], but opted to return to UCSB for his senior season.{{cite news |title= Orlando Johnson returning to UCSB for senior season|author= Andrew Masuda|newspaper= KSBY.com |date= May 9, 2011|url=http://www.ksby.com/news/orlando-johnson-returning-to-ucsb-forgoing-nba-draft/ |accessdate=December 30, 2011}} Prior to the start of his senior season, Johnson was named to the preseason watch lists for the [[Wooden Award]],{{cite web| title = John R. Wooden Award Announces Men’s Preseason Top 50 List| publisher = Wooden Award| year = 2011 | url =http://www.woodenaward.com/?p=1105| accessdate = December 30, 2011}} [[Naismith College Player of the Year|Naismith Award]],{{cite web| title = 2011-12 Naismith Trophy Preseason Watch List| publisher = Slam Magazine| year = 2011 | url =http://www.slamonline.com/online/college-hs/college/2011/11/2011-12-naismith-trophy-preseason-watch-list/| accessdate = December 30, 2011}} and the [[Lowe's Senior CLASS Award]].{{cite web| title = NCAA men’s and women’s basketball candidates announced for 2011-12 Lowe’s Senior CLASS Award| publisher = Lowe's Senior CLASS| year = 2011 | url =http://www.seniorclassaward.com/news/view/ncaa_mens_and_womens_basketball_candidates_announced_for_2011-12_lowes_seni/| accessdate = December 30, 2011}} ==International career== Following his junior season at UCSB, Johnson was chosen to represent the United States as a member of [[United States men's national basketball team|Team USA]] at the [[2011 Summer Universiade|2011 World University Games]] in [[Shenzhen]], [[China]]. He played in all 8 matches of the tournament, averaging 7.3 points and 3.9 rebounds per game as the team finished 7-1.{{cite web| title = Twenty-sixth World University Games| publisher = USA Basketball| year = 2011 | url =http://www.usabasketball.com/mens/worlduniversity/mwug_2011.html| accessdate = December 30, 2011}} ==References== {{Reflist}} ==External links== *[http://www.ucsbgauchos.com/sports/m-baskbl/2011-12/bios/johnson_orlando00.html UCSB Athletic profile] {{Big West Conference Men's Basketball Player of the Year navbox}} {{Persondata | NAME = Johnson, Orlando | ALTERNATIVE NAMES = | SHORT DESCRIPTION = American college basketball player | DATE OF BIRTH = March 11, 1989 | PLACE OF BIRTH = [[Monterey, California]] | DATE OF DEATH = | PLACE OF DEATH = }} {{DEFAULTSORT:Johnson, Orlando}} [[Category:1989 births]] [[Category:Living people]] [[Category:Basketball players from California]] [[Category:Loyola Marymount Lions men's basketball players]] [[Category:People from Monterey, California]] [[Category:Shooting guards]] [[Category:UC Santa Barbara Gauchos men's basketball players]]
